records.rationale: A protocol-neutral layout gives mobile and artifact-panel templates a shared responsive structure without owning conversation state.

evidence.ordinaryDataApi: Accepts React children and an optional artifact panel; no SDK message types.
evidence.accessibility: Preserves document order, zoom reflow, landmarks, RTL, and reduced-motion behavior.
evidence.state: The application owns messages, requests, routing, and panel visibility.
evidence.streaming: Layout does not subscribe to or buffer streams.
evidence.localization: All visible content is supplied by the consumer.
evidence.security: No HTML parsing or remote-resource rendering.
evidence.ssr: CSS controls responsive layout over deterministic markup.
evidence.performance: Layout adds no observers and bounds the message scroll region.
evidence.ownership: Presentation only; transport, persistence, and model state are excluded.
evidence.migration: Existing flex/grid chat screens can adopt the slots incrementally.

records.rationale: A labelled log with an explicit live-region policy is difficult to reproduce safely in each product.

evidence.ordinaryDataApi: Renders caller-owned Message children and accepts standard landmark labels.
evidence.accessibility: Uses log semantics with configurable polite/off announcements and no forced focus movement.
evidence.state: The parent owns items and scroll-follow decisions.
evidence.streaming: Only terminal or caller-batched updates should be announced; chunks are not individually spoken.
evidence.localization: Labels and status text remain caller-provided.
evidence.security: Children render through React; no string-to-HTML conversion.
evidence.ssr: Initial ordered messages render identically on server and client.
evidence.performance: Supports external windowing and does not clone the message collection.
evidence.migration: Existing message arrays remain unchanged and wrap incrementally.

records.rationale: A role-aware message article centralizes stable message identity and speaker semantics while retaining ordinary app data.

evidence.ordinaryDataApi: Accepts a stable id, user/assistant/system role, and React children.
evidence.accessibility: Uses an article with an accessible label supplied or derived from the role.
evidence.state: Message status is descriptive input; the component owns no request lifecycle.
evidence.streaming: The same stable message ID is retained while caller-owned text changes.
evidence.localization: Default role labels use Tale operational messages only when available; custom labels override them.
evidence.security: Plain React text/content only, with no raw HTML prop.
evidence.ssr: Stable IDs and role attributes hydrate deterministically.
evidence.performance: One wrapper per message and no subscriptions.
evidence.ownership: Message semantics, not storage, ordering, or transport.
evidence.migration: Existing message records map directly by id and role.

records.rationale: A role-inheriting visual bubble keeps alignment and long-content behavior consistent without duplicating message semantics.

evidence.ordinaryDataApi: Accepts React children and inherits role through Chat context.
evidence.accessibility: Adds no landmark or live region; long text wraps and remains zoom-safe.
evidence.streaming: Text updates in place under the parent message identity.
evidence.performance: One styled wrapper with no measurement.
evidence.migration: Replaces ad hoc bubble wrappers without changing message data.

records.rationale: A metadata slot provides consistent low-emphasis placement for caller-formatted timestamps, status, and attribution.

evidence.ordinaryDataApi: Accepts caller-rendered React content rather than a protocol timestamp or status shape.
evidence.accessibility: Metadata remains perceivable and does not rely on color alone.
evidence.streaming: Caller may update terminal status without changing structure.
evidence.localization: Caller owns date/time formatting and translated labels.
evidence.migration: Existing metadata nodes can move without data conversion.

records.rationale: A separate component duplicates Message; system output is represented by Chat.Message role="system".

evidence.ordinaryDataApi: The ordinary role field already expresses system messages.
evidence.accessibility: One message semantic avoids divergent labels and announcement behavior.
evidence.state: No separate state model is justified.
evidence.streaming: System messages follow the same stable-ID and batching contract.
evidence.localization: One role-label override path is sufficient.
evidence.security: A separate component would not improve the plain-text boundary.
evidence.ssr: The shared Message path is deterministic.
evidence.performance: Avoids duplicate code and registry surface.

records.rationale: A form-based composer can standardize submit semantics and disabled/busy behavior while leaving draft and transport state controlled.

evidence.ordinaryDataApi: Uses standard form props and caller-composed TextArea/Button controls.
evidence.accessibility: Native form submit semantics preserve keyboard operation and labelling.
evidence.state: Draft, busy, cancellation, and request state remain controlled by the parent.
evidence.streaming: The composer does not start streams; submit callbacks may do so.
evidence.localization: Placeholder, labels, and actions are caller-provided.
evidence.security: Submits plain form data and never renders it as HTML.
evidence.performance: No keystroke state is duplicated internally.
evidence.migration: Existing controlled text areas and submit handlers compose directly.

records.rationale: A disclosure-based tool-call surface standardizes collapsed, running, success, and error states without executing tools.

evidence.ordinaryDataApi: Accepts a string label, four-state enum, and React summary/details.
evidence.accessibility: Disclosure interaction remains keyboard-operable and status is conveyed in text.
evidence.state: Open state can be controlled/defaulted; tool execution remains external.
evidence.streaming: Running-to-terminal updates retain stable tool-call identity.
evidence.localization: Labels and state descriptions can be caller-provided.
evidence.security: Displays plain React content and never executes payloads or raw HTML.
evidence.ssr: Default expansion and state are deterministic.
evidence.performance: Collapsed details can remain mounted only when requested by the caller.
evidence.ownership: Display state only; execution, approval, and results belong to the application.
evidence.migration: Existing tool records map to id, label, state, summary, and details.

records.rationale: A small reducer for ordered text chunks prevents duplicate, stale, and post-terminal updates without coupling to a transport.

evidence.ordinaryDataApi: Consumes serializable stream/message IDs, integer sequence numbers, text chunks, and terminal states.
evidence.accessibility: Returns batched text; callers choose deliberate live-region announcements.
evidence.state: State is immutable and caller-owned; reducer results reject mismatched stream/message IDs.
evidence.streaming: Accepts ordered chunks, rejects duplicates/stale chunks, supports cancellation and terminal states.
evidence.localization: Operates on opaque text and does not translate or segment content.
evidence.security: Never interprets text as HTML or Markdown.
evidence.ssr: Initial state is serializable and deterministic.
evidence.performance: Linear append with bounded caller-controlled chunk batching.
evidence.ownership: Ordering utility only; network transport and persistence are excluded.
evidence.migration: Transport adapters translate their events into the ordinary chunk contract.
